profile_md: UT Austin has several employer-linked team routes, distributed by school rather than institution-wide. The strongest is the LBJ School Policy Research Project, a year-long second-year MPAff capstone in which teams work for a real client (agencies, school district, foundations) and deliver a report; a Spring 2026 section is listed. Cockrell ECE and ME require senior capstones with company-submitted projects (teams of 5-7 and 3-4; company technical mentors in ECE), but pages are undated. McCombs offers MBA micro-consulting (McCombs+ Projects, 8-10 weeks, extracurricular) and a campus-wide graduate Startup Consulting Practicum (applications open for Fall 2026 and Spring 2027, team structure unstated). Moody's The Lab runs agency-style campaigns for clients such as State Farm (Spring 2025), though some clients, e.g. Texas Athletics, are internal units. The legacy PUC service-learning sequence is open to engineering and social work undergraduates (applications to August 2026), but team structure and NGO roles are not evidenced. No university-wide scheme was verified.
gaps: Architecture, design and Dell Medical only covered by one combined query. Further departmental capstones likely (aerospace, biomedical, materials, CS). 2026/27 client rosters not found. Harkey Institute not researched.
